notablePrerequisites: Lurking Roper does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Cast Niveous Wisps by paying {W}, causing Lurking Roper to become white until end of turn and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Lurking Roper by tapping it, causing you to gain 1 life.
Lurking Roper triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat from step 2.
